note: The anchors, anti-defaults, codes and scales in the prompt are rendered from rubric.json `definition` at run time (lib/rubrics/engines/consult-prompts.ts), so the prompt cannot drift from the rubric. This file holds the fixed framing.
rules: Read the consultation transcript only. Score the PATIENT in the chair.
Every evidence item is a quote copied EXACTLY from the transcript (same words, same script); never paraphrase, never invent.
Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else.
If the transcript has no usable consultation (no speech, only connection checks), answer {"scorable": false}.
Use medium for reassurance only as the anchors allow: it is not the default bucket.
Each audible recommendation is one item in `recommendations` with one or two uptake codes and the resolution type of its thread.
cases_lite is a structural overlay, kept apart from the four affect axes: never let it change an axis.
user_header: CONSULTATION TRANSCRIPT. Times are mm:ss from the start of the consultation. Speakers: doctor, other (the patient and anyone with them), unknown.
